name: Tsubakimoto Chain Co.
summary: Tsubakimoto Chain Co. manufactures and sells chains, motion control, mobility, materials handling products in Japan. The company offers power transmission products include drive, small size, large size, plastic modular, top, and plastic block chains; sprockets, house and cable carrier systems, timing belts and pulleys, reducers, locking devices, shaft couplings, linear actuators, electrical controllers, mechanical protectors, and clutches.
